text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne — a passionate and hard-working full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building web platforms.

I can help you bring your Shopify and web presence together so customers can order directly, your menus stay accurate, and your orders and customer data are tracked in one place. I understand you need support across multiple locations, listings, and delivery channels, plus a cleaner setup for updates and marketing.

One relevant project I built was a white-label class booking app for fitness studios using Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Stripe. It supported each studio on its own subdomain, with timetables and memberships, and helped onboard 64 studios in 6 months.

I’m comfortable working across the full stack with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, and I’d be glad to discuss the best way to structure this project.
